EV-09.heading: Independent oil-label dataset and geometry/mechanism holdouts
EV-09.text: The admission and disjoint-holdout software foundation is delivered. Real independently labelled surrogate training, OOD error and calibration remain deferred: no admitted independent Cout labels or reviewed observed-mechanism inventory exist. The authored-family screen summaries are sandbox diagnostics and cannot close this acceptance gate.

required_contents: Reviewed source-bound Cout observations in mg per litre of dispersed oil, with exact concentration basis, input duty, reject fraction, units, uncertainty components and applicability envelope.

Independent oil-grade observations from qualified full-residence, closed-inventory oil evaluation or independently validated measurements; carrier pressure diagnostics and prior-screen targets do not count as Cout labels.

Exact genome, IR, compiled geometry, surface/volume mesh or specimen, case, requirement, scenario, model, solver/build and data-source identities, plus live trusted evidence references and reviewer decisions.

Geometry-observed features and reviewed geometry-cluster/family membership; field-observed mechanism assignments with their own sources. Authored label or gene activation alone establishes neither geometry novelty nor an observed mechanism.

Independent preparation/replicate identifiers and grouping metadata needed to prevent replicate, near-duplicate-geometry and mechanism leakage. The replication design is preregistered from uncertainty/power analysis, not chosen to produce a desired result.

unblocking_holdouts: Freeze requirements, feature contract, label admission, geometry clustering, mechanism membership, metrics and uncertainty/coverage protocol before fitting; resolve every trusted evidence reference and revocation dependency.
Run leave-geometry-family-out folds with geometry clusters and independent preparations disjoint between train and test; no duplicate or near-duplicate subject may cross a fold.

Run leave-observed-mechanism-out folds using reviewed field-derived mechanism membership, with overlapping geometry/preparation groups excluded from training; do not substitute authored family names for mechanism observations.

Fit through fit_independent only after every fold meets the declared estimator and dataset sufficiency rules. Retain per-subject train/test membership, predictions, residuals and uncertainty intervals so another reviewer can recompute RMSE/MAE and interval coverage with uncertainty.

Publish a source-bound calibration table and failed/insufficient/OOD abstentions, including negative tests for prior-derived labels, missing observed features, leakage and revoked sources. Missing folds remain Insufficient; no zero-error fallback or claim promotion.
EV-09.next_owners: INT supplies/reviews independent data and preregistration; IR supplies observed geometry/field receipts and reviewed mechanism assignments; EV admits labels and executes disjoint OOD/calibration checks; DOC reports the resulting evidence tier.

EV-12.heading: Historical and FEA case identity manifests
EV-12.text: EV-12 closure in this PR is scoped to the current Wave-4 OpenFOAM case identity chain, contingent on the every-run manifest audit. Historical OpenFOAM cases and future FEA cases are deferred. A tested schema or prepared surface-only bundle does not establish a complete executed-case identity.
historical_unblock: Inventory each original historical case and identify its exact retained source program, IR/compiler, compiled geometry, executed mesh, solver dictionaries, initial/boundary conditions, solver build and output subject. Correct copied case/model/path metadata only from retained source evidence.

Bind original artifact bytes and their inventories to the manifest, retain an independent audit receipt, and verify all required identities without inferring missing hashes from family labels or another case.

When original executed artifacts were deleted or cannot be attributed, retain the historical identity as incomplete. A newly generated mesh or rerun is a new subject/run with its own identity, not a backfilled identity for the original result.
fea_unblock: Implement the FEA writer and capture the actual structural geometry/mesh, solver case/build, boundary and load-transfer artifacts, material/process passport or explicit missing state, requirements and scenario identities before execution.

Verify the full joil-evidence CaseManifest/ScientificIdentity chain and exact artifact bytes, bind outputs to that subject, and add positive/negative writer tests for changed mesh, changed loads/material, missing stages and cross-case substitution.

Numerical verification, conservative load transfer, material/process validation and physical applicability remain separate claim gates. Manifest completion alone does not establish structural qualification.
EV-12.next_owners: IR owns compiler/case writers; INT owns retained historical run evidence and execution integration; EV owns identity contracts and independent every-manifest verification; DOC records scoped closure and this deferral.
